additional_info.body:
Dear Cenoiu Catalin George,
We have analyzed the logs related to the offline query fo:
RVP / T5 170004818
I wanted to inform you that charger outlets were temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error.
We’d like to inform you that the COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the Si-D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue, charger outlets were temporarily unavailable. The issue has been resolved, Outlets are available now.
RVP / T5 170004820
Charger is now functioning correctly and maintaining a stable OCPP connection with your backend.
Following your earlier report regarding the charger offline status on 11th July, error “OCPP Offline” may have resulted from a temporary misconfiguration or network issue that appears to be resolved.
Additionally we observed that outlet 2 is out of order due to cable temperature issue, kindly create a new ticket to resolve this issue at your earliest connivence.
If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
